messages.text:
Hi,

I’m reaching out from *Youdao A.* , a creator partnership platform operated by *NetEase Youdao*.

We recently came across your channel and thought your content might be a potential fit for some of the creator campaigns available through *InfunEase*.

Creators can use *InfunEase* to browse campaign details, review deliverables and proposed compensation, and decide which opportunities are relevant before applying. Our team also supports brand communication and campaign coordination throughout the collaboration process.

We have established an official partnership with *YouTube Creator Partnerships* , bringing creators higher-quality brand collaboration opportunities.

*If you’re open to exploring potential brand collaborations, you can take a quick look here:* View available campaigns ( https://nxzdk.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ6uvdOeWkTWhGDpLXnGsD0hF/rH1CsDLFtqNs ) Registration is free, and there’s no obligation to apply for or accept any campaign.

*Even without finishing registration immediately* , you can still submit your channel through this link for campaign review. If your channel gets shortlisted, we will send you a dedicated email for further cooperation. Youdao A. Campaigns 2026.10 Week3 ( https://nxzdk.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ72ihQrn6Z0N1xz8ga9zSiJN/81YLdjX7bA1Q )

You’re also welcome to join our creator communities for campaign updates and support:

* Join our Discord Community ( https://nxzdk.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7AVlT53SeU2ni8vpN36iPvV/WHGfISCGNoYU )
* Join our Whatsapp Community ( https://nxzdk.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7IIpVIJojxiZSIiy9wDy7Xd/LEtBEr15Vlec )

If you have any questions, contact us at (email hidden) ( (email hidden) )

Best regards,
Youdao A. Team

Note to the team: This is a marketing solicitation, not a customer. No reply is needed, and I should not click the links or sign anything up. For the record: this email is a cold pitch from a creator-marketing platform asking us to register a channel through tracked links. It is not a sales enquir…
